explication: Dinky is a Flink-centered real-time computing platform. Its principal workflow is developing SQL or CDC work in the studio, validating or debugging it, then submitting it for execution and monitoring. The README also describes metadata/catalog access, resource and cluster management, savepoints, alerts, and tenant administration. Sampled sources show job orchestration, execution setup, resource-manager selection, and fragment-variable management; many other links below reflect documented capabilities rather than inspected call sites.
